manual.title: Enter official hall readings
manual.description: Enter current readings from your account or leave them blank. Use decimal GB. Only enter general data from the monthly plan.

manual_update.title: Record a new reading
manual_update.description: A new balance replaces the old balance. If you enter any traffic field, the traffic group is replaced and blank traffic fields become unavailable.

sms.title: Set up SMS forwarding
sms.description: Enter at least one complete template based on a verified message. Find the secret webhook path under Reconfigure after setup.

sms_update.title: Configure SMS forwarding
sms_update.description: Append this secret path to your local Home Assistant URL: `{path}`. Keep it private. A change to the sender, templates or unit base clears the current readings.

h5_start.title: Sign in to China Broadnet
h5_start.description: Use China Broadnet’s official mobile website login. Submitting this form requests one login SMS. Review the carrier’s user agreement and privacy policy on the [official mobile website]({website}).

data.name: Account alias
data.consent: I agree to the carrier’s terms and want to request an SMS code

h5_code.title: Verify the login SMS
h5_code.description:
China Broadnet accepted the SMS request. The code is valid for five minutes. If you have not received the SMS, you can request another after 60 seconds.

{timer}

h5_update.title: Automatic queries and general data packages
h5_update.description: Queries run every 8 minutes by default, which can help reduce sign-ins after periods of inactivity. Confirmed monthly general packages are all selected by default. If no options appear, reopen this screen after a successful usage refresh.

desktop_start.title: Image CAPTCHA login (experimental)
desktop_start.description:
Open Home Assistant from your local network and enter the characters below and your phone number. Submitting requests one login SMS. Review the user agreement and privacy policy at the [official website]({website}). When the timer reaches zero, submit to load a new image.

![China Broadnet CAPTCHA]({image})

desktop_retry.title: Image CAPTCHA unavailable
desktop_retry.description: Submit to retry loading the image, or close this flow and choose phone and SMS login. This step does not send an SMS.

error.invalid_refresh_minutes: Enter a whole number from 5 to 60.
error.invalid_sender: Enter an exact sender of up to 64 characters.
error.invalid_template: Use a complete template and the documented placeholders.
error.invalid_portal_session: Check the exported session and request headers.
error.portal_auth_failed: The carrier rejected the session. Refresh the website credentials.
error.cannot_connect: The carrier query failed. Try again later.
error.invalid_portal_curl: Use Copy as cURL (bash) on the qryBalanceFee request in the Network panel.
error.portal_challenge: China Broadnet returned a browser verification page to Home Assistant. Check whether Home Assistant and your browser use the same internet connection.
error.login_consent: Confirm the carrier terms and SMS request.
error.invalid_package: Enter a package name of at most 128 characters.
error.sms_cooldown: Wait at least 60 seconds before requesting another SMS.
error.sms_rejected: China Broadnet rejected the SMS request. Try again later.
error.invalid_sms_code: Enter a valid SMS code. Check whether it has expired.
error.captcha_challenge: China Broadnet returned a browser verification page instead of the CAPTCHA image.
error.invalid_image_code: Enter the characters shown in the image.
error.invalid_desktop_codes: China Broadnet rejected the CAPTCHA or SMS code. Restart this backup login flow if the image code has expired.
error.sms_expired: The code has expired. Request a new SMS.
